lines.text: Attention. Northline station is out of operation. You are kindly requested to vacate the station.
lines.instruct: A female automated station announcer. Speak in a flat monotone with minimal pitch variation, evenly spaced words, precise consonants and a steady measured pace. Emotionless, detached, no warmth, no dramatic emphasis, no whispering.
lines.note: First announcement during the camera approach.

lines.text: Your continued presence has been recorded. Any violations will be persecuted. Thank you for your cooperation.
lines.instruct: A female automated station announcer. Speak in a flat monotone with minimal pitch variation, evenly spaced words, precise consonants and a steady measured pace. Emotionless, detached, no warmth, no dramatic emphasis, no whispering.
lines.note: Persecuted is intentional horror copy, as requested.

lines.text: This is your final courtesy reminder. Follow the illuminated exit signs. Do not board the passing service. Kindly vacate the station.
lines.instruct: A female automated station announcer. Speak in a flat monotone with minimal pitch variation, evenly spaced words, precise consonants and a steady measured pace. Emotionless, detached, no warmth, no dramatic emphasis, no whispering.
lines.note: Repeat cycle is spaced to avoid overlapping train passes.
